<includeonly><span style="color:{{{1|inherit}}};">{{{2|}}}</span></includeonly><noinclude>
== Purpose ==
Colours a run of text. '''pdxparse''' emits <code><nowiki>{{color|green|...}}</nowiki></code>,
<code><nowiki>{{color|red|...}}</nowiki></code> and <code><nowiki>{{color|yellow|...}}</nowiki></code>
when the game script itself specifies a colour.

== Usage ==
<pre>
{{color|green|+10 stability}}
</pre>

== Contrast ==
Bare <code>yellow</code> and <code>green</code> fail contrast checks on a white
background. Prefer mapping the common names to darker shades:

<pre>
&lt;includeonly&gt;&lt;span style="color:{{#switch:{{lc:{{{1|}}}}}
 | green  = #1a7f37
 | red    = #cf222e
 | yellow = #9a6700
 | #default = {{{1|inherit}}}
}};"&gt;{{{2|}}}&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/includeonly&gt;
</pre>
